analysis: Examined both reference excerpts, submodule metadata/pointer change, and the added test's metadata, patch and full source. No concrete security regression is independently supported by the supplied source. libs/mlx-swift-lm:1 advances 14661d9 to 2068c938, but its implementation diff is absent; this is a material coverage limit for TB-007, T-041, A-001 and resource availability. docs/reference/ssd-kv-cache.md:119 describes provider-staged host-zero destinations that skip eval/fences and can transiently commit up to 64 MiB outside the MLX allocator. Integration must inspect CheckpointHostZeros.swift, CompleteCheckpointTransfer.swift, PagedCheckpointStorage.swift and CompleteCheckpointImportPlan.swift in that dependency: verify initialization, alias lifetime, synchronization, peak-memory admission and retirement/refund ordering against concurrent prefill. Documentation alone does not prove these properties or establish the exact delta without base text. The reference also retains authenticated manifests, tenant/prefix binding, HMAC names, TTL and bounded retry contracts (lines 105-126, 148-154, 174-197, 277-299); their implementations were not supplied. ModelCheckpointRestoreContentionLiveTests.swift:17,51-56 makes the benchmark opt-in; lines 97-120 assign distinct foreign scopes and exercise overlapping work, while 135-138 check restored boundary and TTFT. The two-second delay at 114 does not establish that foreign prefill is still active, and the test does not establish isolation, output parity or memory bounds. Reports/logs contain counts, timings and model identity rather than prompt content (19-35,177-184). No supplied change demonstrates altered serving authorization, encryption, billing or privileged-helper behavior. Unchanged fixture/session callers and dependency implementations need examination before concluding runtime safety.
